prompt_text: Solve the riddle. "My scream catches your attention. Hearing it is not always the  pleasant experience, but not missing hearing me is always worse. I work as hard as you do"
response_text:
**Answer: a fire (smoke) alarm**

**Why it fits**

| Line of the riddle | How a fire alarm matches |
|--------------------|--------------------------|
| *“My scream catches your attention.”* | When it goes off the alarm lets out a loud, piercing “scream” that instantly draws everyone’s focus. |
| *“Hearing it is not always the pleasant experience…”* | The blaring sound is jarring and unpleasant – it startles you, wakes you up, and can be painful to hear. |
| *“…but not missing hearing me is always worse.”* | Ignoring or not hearing the alarm can mean missing a fire or dangerous situation, which can be deadly. |
| *“I work as hard as you do.”* | A fire alarm is on duty 24 hours a day, every day, just like a diligent worker who never rests. |

So the riddle is describing the **fire (or smoke) alarm** that constantly watches, screams loudly when danger appears, and whose sound is unpleasant but far better to hear than to miss.
